next.reason: 1985: OBJECT-COMPUTER. [ computer-name [MEMORY SIZE integer-1 {WORDS|CHARACTERS|MODULES}] [PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS alphabet-name-1] . ]: the clauses need computer-name. §2023:12.3.6.2 writes [ computer-name-1 ] and the CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION and PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE clauses (with FOR ALPHANUMERIC / FOR NATIONAL) as independent options, and has no MEMORY SIZE clause; §2023:12.3.6.3 SR4: "If neither computer-name-1 nor any of the optional clauses is specified, the second period in the General format may be omitted." A 1985 program with MEMORY SIZE is refused; clauses without computer-name are newly accepted. Compile-time only.
